sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Test Analyst / QA Engineer== with 6+ years of experience ==planning, designing, executing and automating test scenarios== across functional, integration, system, regression and end-to-end suites for enterprise web applications and integrations. ==Strong background validating customer journeys, agent workflows, CRM integrations, API and event-driven data flows== across AWS Marketplace, Salesforce, HubSpot and SaaS commerce platforms. Automated 270+ regression test cases (BrowserStack LCNC, ACCELQ), performed defect tracking, triage, retesting and closure, and supported UAT planning, release validation and production deployments. ==Experienced in API testing (Postman, REST Assured), SQL data validation, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) and cross-functional collaboration with BAs, architects, developers and operations==.
